mapper.select: SELECT id, brand_id, category_id, name, price, stock, sale, detail, status FROM pms_product
SELECT * FROM pms_product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1

SELECT sg.id, sg.goods_id, sg.seckill_price, sg.start_time, sg.end_time, sg.stock, CASE WHEN sg.start_time > NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS status, sg.create_time, sg.update_time, p.name AS product_name, p.detail AS product_detail, p.price AS product_price FROM seckill_goods sg INNER JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = sg.goods_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND sg.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY sg.start_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_order ( id, user_id, goods_id, payable_amount, pay_status, create_time, pay_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{payableAmount}, #{payStatus}, #{createTime}, #{payTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_order SET pay_status = #{payStatus}, pay_time = CASE WHEN #{payStatus} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE pay_time END WHERE id = #{id} AND pay_status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_goods ( goods_id, seckill_price, start_time, end_time, stock, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{goodsId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
